transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Well, what brings me in is... I just can't seem to keep my work in order anymore. I work at a dry cleaners, and lately, the tickets, receipts, workshop notes, customer jobs—they're all just getting piled together. It gets to a point where I look at the mess and I honestly do not know what to handle first. It's really starting to become a problem for me.
Have you struggled with this kind of disorganization your entire life, or is this a relatively new development?

It's really been my whole life, to be honest. Even back when I was in grade school, my teachers would tell my mother that I was bright, but... just scattered. I was always talking out of turn, losing my school papers, and they constantly had to give me reminders to actually finish my work. So, yeah, it's definitely not a new thing for me.
